# olivares_policies (Data Source)

Reads the governance policies in the Olivares AI control plane (read-only). Requires governance:policy:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "olivares_policies" "abac" {
  kind = "abac"
}

output "abac_policy_names" {
  value = [for p in data.olivares_policies.abac.policies : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Filter by policy kind ("abac" or "approval"). Omit for all kinds.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) The matching governance policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active.
- `id` (String) Policy ID.
- `kind` (String) Policy kind.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `spec` (String) The engine's canonical policy spec as a JSON document.
